reason: F3/F4: rendered attack_prompts 2 and 3 leak raw assistant-model noise into the payload. Sample 3 contains meta-commentary inside the target-facing message (e.g. "*Rationale: This is the target prompt. The progression has built up to a general request for an exploit script.*" and "*Rationale: Adds a framing element (article generation)...*"), and samples 2 & 3 are littered with stray quote marks and bold-marker residue between bullets (e.g. "...layered security approaches."" then a loose "**"). _parse_steps' regex fell through to a naive line-split fallback whose lines were never run through _clean_step, and _clean_step's annotation stripper only removed *(...)* (parenthesized) annotations, so unannotated *Rationale...* blocks and quote/asterisk cruft reached the final payload. Fixed by making _clean_step strip *Rationale:...*/bold-marker/quote residue and by having _build_attack_prompt clean+filter every step (dropping empty meta-lines) before rendering; substance (escalation to the malicious target, ~12 steps, on-topic) is otherwise faithful.
